I recently completed my Ladakh trip with Puga Adventure, organized by Nurboo and Jonathan, and it turned out to be one of the best travel experiences I’ve ever had. The entire itinerary was perfectly planned, covering all the must-visit places — Leh, Nubra Valley, Pangong, Hanle, and Tso Moriri — without feeling rushed or tiring.

We got some of the best stay options at every stop and a top-quality bike that made the ride smooth and enjoyable. What really stood out was the way they took care of every small detail — from managing our luggage during the bike rides to helping us with any issues on the way. Thanks to their constant support, we could just focus on enjoying the beauty of Ladakh without any worries.

Both Nurboo and Jonathan were super friendly, well-organized, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They made sure everyone in the group felt comfortable and had an amazing time throughout.

I’d highly recommend Puga Adventure to anyone planning to explore Ladakh — whether you’re joining a group trip or planning a private journey, you’ll be in the best hands possible. Truly a memorable and well-managed adventure! 🏔️🏍️
